fair_value_reason: The revised agent fair values are $1,130 / $1,155 / $1,130 / $1,175 / $1,170 (mean $1,152). The remaining spread comes from 2028 EPS ($50.75-53.5) and multiples (22-24x), with no factual error left to correct. Consensus NTM EPS of ~$51.4 (0.25 x $47.5 + 0.75 x ~$52.7) x 22.5x gives ~$1,157; cash-flow cross-checks give ~$1,020-1,040. I use $1,150, effectively the mean.
supervisor_summary: After round 2 the five forecasts converge: fair values of $1,130-1,175 and P(close >= $1,150 in Oct 2027) of 0.51-0.52, all anchored on consensus NTM EPS of ~$50-52 at a 22-24x multiple. My checks confirmed the remaining contested facts: AtaiBeckley closed Sep 11, so a Q3 IPR&D charge and a mechanical guide cut are likely on Oct 29; BGH data shows ~1 in 10 covering employers dropping GLP-1 obesity coverage in 2027; and no priority voucher for retatrutide turned up, so approval inside the horizon is unlikely. None of these moves the distribution materially, so the mean ladder stands (median ~$1,155, roughly flat against spot), with confidence low. Watch Q3 on Oct 29, the 7th Circuit opinion and the January 2027 price resets.
key_drivers: Volume vs price: Q2 US volume +37% against ~-9% underlying US price. The January 2027 resets (Novo $675 list, CVS co-preferred from Oct 1, $245 Medicare) and BGH's ~1-in-10 employer coverage drops in 2027 are the test.
Consensus earnings path: 2027 EPS $47.51 (revisions skewed up) and 2028 ~$51-53, so NTM EPS at the horizon is ~$50-52 and the multiple must compress from ~24x as growth slows to ~11-12%.
Medicare: 700k Bridge starts with 70% on Lilly. The Bridge ends 2027-12-31 with no successor (BALANCE Part D delayed), an overhang the market will price by the horizon.
Oral race: Foundayo at ~47.5k weekly scripts and one-third of new oral starts, vs the Wegovy pill at ~170k.

Retatrutide: BLA in Q1 2027 with a decision most likely in early 2028. The 7th Circuit BLA/NDA opinion (argued Sep 24) is a terminal-value binary. Recurring IPR&D (AtaiBeckley in Q3) weighs on reported EPS.
